sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i apps/mobile/android/app/build.gradle
wget -q -O /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -- https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.20.0/node-v22.20.0-linux-x64.tar.xz

export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v22.20.0-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
npm ci
npm run build -w @colota/shared
sed -i 's/getHostIpAddress(),/project.properties["reactNativeDevServerIp"]?.toString() ?:\ "localhost",/' node_modules/@react-native/gradle-plugin/react-native-gradle-plugin/src/main/kotlin/com/facebook/react/utils/AgpConfiguratorUtils.kt

pushd apps/mobile/android
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew clean assembleFossRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/foss/release/app-foss-arm64-v8a-*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
